bottom_line: Ticket sales rose from $28,000 to $35,000 — can the festival cover its $120,000 cost without a bigger council grant?

headline.dek: A $120,000 festival, paid for by the council, ticket buyers and sponsors.
headline.title: Fallowfield's summer festival, paid for three ways

scenes.question: Where does the festival money come from?
scenes.why: The story is one total with three named parts — shares of a whole, not peers being compared, so a breakdown shows it and a bar chart would not.
